title: A Phone Lesson
text:
Maria has a new phone. She uses it to send messages to her family every day. Her brother sends her funny photos, and her mother sends good morning messages. Maria is happy because she can talk to everyone quickly.

One night, Maria forgot to charge her phone. In the morning, the battery was empty. She could not read her messages, so she borrowed her father's phone to call her friend. Her friend laughed and said, 'Charge your phone next time!'

questions.text: What does Maria use her phone for every day?
options: To send messages to her family

questions.text: Why did Maria borrow her father's phone?
options: Her father wanted to call her

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about her new phone?
What can you infer about Maria's friend?
options: She is a little annoyed but still friendly
She is angry with Maria's father
She does not have a phone

paragraph_translations: María tiene un teléfono nuevo. Lo usa para enviar mensajes a su familia todos los días. Su hermano le envía fotos divertidas, y su madre le manda mensajes de buenos días. María está contenta porque puede hablar con todos rápidamente.

Una noche, María olvidó cargar su teléfono. Por la mañana, la batería estaba vacía. No podía leer sus mensajes, así que pidió prestado el teléfono de su padre para llamar a su amiga. Su amiga se rio y dijo: '¡Carga tu teléfono la próxima vez!'
